To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have successfully designed a general limited scheduling method for a distributed communication systems, which has a modular architecture, and have analyzed its performance by means of imbedded markov chain.

the general limited scheduling is a good scheduling mechanism for distributed communication system, and it is possible to design a system with the general limited mechanism and an optimal pattern via a genetic algorithm.

the general limited scheduling is a good alternative scheduling mechanism for distributed systems and the optimal pattern of the general limited service discipline can be found by using a genetic algorithm.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a new scheduling mechanism for a modular distributed system and its optimal-pattern design.
the general limited service discipline of a distributed communication system and its optimal-pattern design.
an analysis of a general limited service discipline and its optimal pattern design for the distributed communication systems with modular architectures.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the general limited scheduling is a very useful scheduling mechanism in a distributed communication system.
the general limited scheduling is an effective scheduling mechanism for a modular distributed communication system.
our general limited scheduling mechanism is more flexible, efficient and practical in the design of a distributed communication system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
our analysis and the optimal pattern design of the general scheduling mechanism for the system can provide a useful reference for the distributed system design.
the general limited scheduling mechanisms can be a good candidate for distributed communication systems.

the general limited scheduling discipline can provide the optimal scheduling patterns for a distributed communication systems, and the genetic algorithm is a useful tool to find the optimal scheduling patterns.

the general limited scheduling mechanisms and its optimal patterns can be applied to the distributed communication system.
the general limited scheduling is more efficient and more effective than the other scheduling mechanisms.
the general limited scheduling mechanisms can improve the system performance of distributed communication systems.
